name: V41.eligibility-ks-submit-standard-default
description: Brief 55 acceptance: the canonical Sample BOP appetite gate (ordered rules decline-knockout > floor-area-submit > gross-sales-submit > preferred-credit, default_tier STANDARD) fires SUBMIT on the KS-20 risk (42,000 sq ft > 35,000, Rule 22.A). First-match-wins ordering means the floor-area submit rule beats the bceg_1 preferred credit (the §3.3 masking fix) — the risk is a referral, not preferred. Distinct from V33, which used the convenience default_tier preferred; the filing's real default is standard (the sample's 19 non-KS-20 rows).

rules.reasoning: Class not in the BOP eligibility table — out of appetite.
Floor area exceeds the 35,000 sq ft BOP eligibility limit (Sample BOP Rule 22.A) — refer to underwriting.
Annual gross sales exceed the $6M referral threshold.

params.default_reasoning: Within BOP appetite at standard filed rates.
